fix_commit_subject: fix(adm): preserve profile object interpolation state

fix.pre_fix: 0 samples on the first and every subsequent Object block
fix.post_fix: 0 samples on the first Object block and 250 samples on every subsequent Object block

closed_semantics: RB rows are decoded JOC output-object PCM within the admitted carrier scope
decoded JOC ordinal j maps to OAMD dynamic ordinal j and total index j+1
OAMD to ADM coordinates remain ADM_X=2*OAMD_X-1, ADM_Y=1-2*OAMD_Y, ADM_Z=OAMD_Z
raw3 admission, PCM storage policy, and authored identity are out of scope

gain.representation: decoded OAMD Gain::Decibels(0), exported scene gain_db=Some(0.0)

trim.semantic_effect: not decoded; no production meaning inferred

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Object order is bed/ISF/dynamic; dynamic slot and JOC output population are validated in the admitted carrier scope.
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: content description establishes the object population; binding profile is admitted only when stable
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: 16 total OAMD entries, 15 dynamic entries, 15 JOC rows; stable admitted mapping

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: b_object_not_active makes the object audio essence silent and removes its contribution for that block.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per object/per metadata block, resolved through block state
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: active bit is decoded per block; inactive forces basic/render defaults; prior state is used only by valid reuse paths
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: EXPORTED_EQUIVALENTLY; inactive records force zero contribution
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: USED_FOR_ADMISSION_ONLY; strict dynamic export rejects inactive transitions, best-effort falls back to neutral metadata
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: all 163984 updates active; no transition; no R00 loss

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Object gain is a decoder-interface dB gain; the linear object signal is multiplied by the decoded gain before spatial contribution. -inf is silence.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per object/per metadata block, with prior-object inheritance for the public reuse code
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: 0 dB, -inf, table-coded dB, or prior object gain according to the gain index
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: EXPORTED_EQUIVALENTLY; BridgeControlAssembler converts dB/-inf to a finite scalar and JocSpatialBridge applies it
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: DROPPED for non-unity values; no active-object ADM gain is written and PCM is not gain-baked
renderer_relevant_fields.target_profile: Dolby Atmos Master ADM Profile does not use gain to express non-unity gain on active Objects; inactive Object PCM must be silent
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: field decoded on every update, but only 0 dB; 0 non-unity updates, so no R00 semantic difference

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Object priority is a decoded object importance value; ETSI Annex B maps it to ADM pack importance.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per object/per metadata block with normal reuse
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: decoder default 0 in the raw object state; explicit default code resolves to 1.0; coded values resolve to bits/32
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: PRESERVED_BUT_NOT_CONSUMED by the current direct bridge
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: DROPPED; target profile only permits gain/importance on inactive Objects
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: all 163984 updates are 1.0; no observed non-default priority state

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Position, distance, screen anchor/factors, and resolved position coding determine the object location; distance and screen geometry are resolved before the renderer boundary.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per object/per metadata block with differential/reuse state resolved to an absolute snapshot
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: room center/default render state; differential and partial fields inherit from the prior block
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: EXPORTED_EQUIVALENTLY into the public spatial bridge
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: EXPORTED_EQUIVALENTLY for admitted finite room positions; screen positions are reduced to their resolved room position and unsupported speaker/ISF dynamic positions reject
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: 153735 room dynamic updates and 10249 speaker-anchor updates; frozen coordinate bridge passed

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: ramp_duration is the public period for interpolation from previous property values to current values; metadata timing also defines exact sample-domain event starts.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per shared metadata block; frame timeline carries absolute sample offsets
renderer_relevant_fields.scope: shared timing plus per-object resolved values
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: coded 0/512/1536/custom timing; R00 uses 1536 for every block
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: EXPORTED_EQUIVALENTLY to the direct bridge scheduler duration
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: APPROXIMATED by sample-derived block starts/durations and Dolby profile jump events; the OAMD ramp number is not serialized as an OAMD field
renderer_relevant_fields.target_profile: Dolby profile uses discrete jumpPosition events and renderer-side smoothing; its normative subsequent interpolationLength is 250 samples, not the OAMD ramp value
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: all 163984 updates use 1536; the pre-fix writer omitted the profile-required 250-sample interpolation on subsequent blocks, now fixed without PCM transformation

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Object size/extent changes point-versus-region contribution and spread behavior.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per object/per metadata block with reuse
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: zero extent default; table-coded uniform or XYZ extent updates
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: EXPORTED_EQUIVALENTLY in the current bridge descriptor
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: DROPPED/UNSUPPORTED in the generated ADM subset
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: all zero extent; no R00 loss

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Channel lock constrains rendering to a speaker; zones constrain allowed renderer regions.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per object/per metadata block with reuse
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: channel lock false and all zones include; partial updates inherit the prior resolved state
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: DROPPED/UNSUPPORTED in the generated ADM subset
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: 0 channel-lock updates and 0 zone-exclude updates; no R00 loss

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Divergence spreads one object into a pair along the X axis.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: per object/per metadata block, with extension reuse
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: zero unless the extended element signals a decoded divergence value
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: PRESERVED_BUT_NOT_CONSUMED by the current automatic bridge
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: NOT_REPRESENTABLE; Dolby Atmos Master ADM Profile forbids objectDivergence
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: 0 nonzero divergence updates; no R00 loss

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Extended precision refines the coded position; differential/reuse coding is a transport mechanism for the resolved current state.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: same object/block state lifetime as position
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: optional precision and differential/reuse fields; resolved into current absolute position before scene/ADM conversion
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: EXPORTED_EQUIVALENTLY through the resolved position; coding bits are intentionally not copied
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: included in the 153735 decoded room-position updates; coordinate regression remains closed

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: Trim changes decoder-side level/warping for screen/out-of-screen object rendering.
renderer_relevant_fields.state_lifetime: global per metadata frame with per-object disable flags
renderer_relevant_fields.default_and_updates: default/disabled/custom configurations; public parser rejects reserved modes
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: UNSUPPORTED when the element is opaque; no meaning is inferred
renderer_relevant_fields.adm_treatment: PRESERVED_BUT_NOT_EXPORTED only when typed scene state exists; no generated ADM trim claim
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: raw warp 3 is opaque and unresolved; no clean decoded trim semantics are available

renderer_relevant_fields.public_semantic: A bounded additional-data window is retained, but its opaque meaning is not invented.
renderer_relevant_fields.direct_joc_treatment: PRESERVED_BUT_NOT_INTERPRETED beyond the closed raw3 guard
renderer_relevant_fields.r00: raw3/warp-3 interpretation remains explicitly out of scope

adm_representation_baseline.pcm: decoded ReconstructionBasis.rows[j] written unchanged as signed 24-bit PCM; base LFE remains a separate bed LFE track
adm_representation_baseline.position: admitted room position converted once to normalized ADM Cartesian X/Y/Z
adm_representation_baseline.gain: no ADM gain element for active Objects; no semantic gain bake
adm_representation_baseline.active_present: strict admission rejects inactive dynamic transitions; best-effort disables decoded dynamic metadata on that error
adm_representation_baseline.timing: sample-domain rtime/duration blocks at each OAMD event boundary; jumpPosition value 1 with interpolationLength 0 on the first Object block and 250 on subsequent blocks
adm_representation_baseline.other_properties: size, priority, channel lock, zones, divergence, trim, and opaque additional data are not claimed as exported ADM semantics

decisions.oamd_gain_public_semantics: dB decoder-interface gain converted to a linear multiplier on the object signal before spatial contribution; negative infinity is silence
